verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Bitwarden serves a live llms.txt at bitwarden.com/llms.txt, and its help pages have per-page markdown mirrors (e.g. /help/cli.md, /help/public-api.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs. The visible llms.txt opening reads like marketing copy, and its full contents were not captured. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage of the help docs (e.g. an index or llms-full.txt), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and independent user corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: help pages ship real per-page .md mirrors — https://bitwarden.com/help/cli.md returns markdown starting '# Password Manager CLI'
